name: Hiki Shiu
source:
Star of the track team and loyal choir member, Shiu is also Tomomi's best friend and staunchest supporter. She is a year younger than Tomomi, and in her final year of high school.

Silly, playful, and a great lover of all kinds of fantasy. She's no good at ad-libbing, but seems to enjoy it nevertheless.

She dyes streaks in her hair to make a visual pun on the kanji in her name.

(from [url=https://dialoguelostloop.tumblr.com/refinery]tumblr[/url])
